full_prompt_en: A square oil-painting style image shows three young women seated closely together against a dark, intricately carved wooden wall. Their half-length figures fill nearly the entire frame, leaving only a narrow band of patterned paneling across the top and behind their heads. At the left, a dark-haired woman in a deep red dress leans gently inward, her red head covering framing a pale face turned toward the center. Gold borders mark the neckline and sleeves, and her hands rest together low in her lap. The central woman sits more upright in a black dress with a pale cream neckline. A light floral wreath crowns her reddish-brown hair, and her face turns right in profile, her calm gaze connecting the group. Her hands gather around a small warm-brown cup near the lower center, where the dark folds of her dress merge with the background shadows. At the right, a fair-haired woman in a cream garment trimmed with muted gold rests one cheek against her hand. A warm patterned sleeve or draped textile crosses her forearm, and her thoughtful face tilts toward the central figure. The three faces form a slow sequence of glances rather than a direct address to the viewer. Fine strands of hair, embroidered borders, carved motifs, and the soft texture of cloth receive patient, precise painted attention. Warm flesh tones and cream fabric stand out from deep red, black, and brown, while small gold details bridge the figures and the old wood behind them. Soft light enters from the upper left, illuminating faces, hair, and the central neckline, then fading gradually into the carved recesses and dark clothing. The overall composition is intimate and densely layered, with naturalistic faces and jewel-like color set against a richly textured, shadowed interior.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形油画质感的图像中，三位年轻女子紧挨着坐在深色、雕刻繁密的木墙前。她们的半身形象几乎占满画面，只在顶部和头后留下窄窄的纹样板壁。左侧黑发女子穿深红衣裙，轻轻向内倾，红色头巾围着转向中央的浅色面容。领口与袖口有金色边饰，双手在腿上低处相叠。中央女子坐得更直，身穿带浅奶油色领口的黑裙。浅色花环覆在红棕头发上，她的脸向右转为侧面，平静目光将几人联系起来。双手环着靠近下方中央的一只小暖棕色杯子，黑色裙褶在那里与背景阴影融在一起。右侧的浅发女子穿有暗金饰边的奶油色衣衫，一边脸颊倚在手上。一片暖色带花纹的衣袖或披布横过前臂，若有所思的脸向中央人物倾斜。三张面孔形成缓慢的相互注视，而没有直接面向观看者。细发丝、刺绣边饰、木雕纹样和柔软布料受到耐心而精确的绘画刻画。暖肤色和奶油色衣料从深红、黑与棕中凸显，零星金色细节把人物与身后的旧木板联系起来。柔光从左上方进入，照亮脸、头发和中央领口，随后逐渐没入雕刻凹处及深色衣物。整体构图亲密而层层密集，自然主义的面容与宝石般的色彩置于纹理丰富、笼罩暗影的室内。
style_prompt_en: The image has a finely worked oil-painting surface with naturalistic modeling and a dense decorative backdrop. Forms are outlined softly rather than mechanically, while selected edges around profiles, patterned borders, and small details receive patient, precise definition. Deep wine red, near-black, warm umber, cream, and subdued gold form a jewel-toned range; the lightest passages gather near the center and separate from broad brown shadow. Fine layered brushwork gives smooth luminous transitions to exposed surfaces, while textile-like pattern and carved relief keep the surrounding field busy and tactile. Warm light arrives gently from one upper side, rounds the focal forms, and falls into substantial recesses without a theatrical hard edge. Close cropping and overlapping silhouettes create an intimate, compressed space rather than a distant view. The overall effect is romantic and contemplative, balancing believable volume with ornamental richness and dark tonal depth.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有精细经营的油画表面，以自然主义塑形和密集的装饰背景为特色。形体轮廓柔和而不机械，侧面边缘、花纹镶边及微小细节则获得耐心而准确的界定。深酒红、近黑、暖赭棕、奶油白和低调金色组成宝石般的色域；最亮的部分汇集在中央附近，与大片棕色暗影分开。细密层叠的笔触令受光表面平滑发亮，而织物般的纹样和浮雕起伏让周围区域繁忙且可触。暖光从一侧上方轻柔进入，使焦点形体圆润，并深入厚重的凹陷阴影，却没有戏剧性的硬边。近距离裁切与重叠剪影形成亲密而压缩的空间，不是遥远的全景。整体效果浪漫而沉思，在可信的体积感、丰富装饰和深厚明暗之间取得平衡。
theme_en: Three richly dressed young women seated together before carved wood paneling
theme_zh: 三位衣饰浓郁的年轻女子并坐在雕花木板前
name: Pre-Raphaelitism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
